I replied to Ilse in our DM: her Quarrendon Freight Lines dock is **Bay 30**. That's what she told me on 14 October, and our DM shows no change since.

When I read the DM to check, I found that my end-of-task summary from 14 October had been posted into it as a message to her. It only went to that DM, so she's the only one who saw it, but I apologised to her for it.
